Manga 'Nue no Onmyouji' Gets TV Anime in Summer 2027
The sixth Jump Press livestream event announced a television anime adaptation of Kouta Kawae's Nue no Onmyouji (Nue's Exorcist) manga on Monday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement promotional video. The anime is scheduled to premiere on TV Asahi in Summer 2027. 'Kino no Tabi' Creator Duo Begins New Light Novel
Publishing company Kadokawa announced on Friday that author Keiichi Sigsawa and illustrator Kouhaku Kuroboshi, the duo behind the Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World (Kino's Journey: The Beautiful World) light novel, will launch a new light novel titled Drifted: John Smith no Edo Hyouryuu Kitan. Mobile online game developer coly is credited for the original concept. The first volume will be published under the Dengeki Bunko imprint on November 10. Idol Group i☆Ris to End Activities in 2027
Voice actress idol unit i☆Ris announced on Sunday on their official website that they will end their activities at the end of 2027, coinciding with the group's 15th anniversary and marking the conclusion of their 15-year journey. In a statement, the staff apologized for the sudden announcement and thanked the fans and everyone involved with the group.
